title: Obadiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Obadiah 1: the word against Edom, the pride that reaches to the stars, the day Jerusalem fell, and the kingdom that will be Yahweh's.

questions.text: Whom does the vision of Obadiah concern?
questions.explanation: The vision of Obadiah is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom.

questions.text: What does verse 3 say has deceived those who dwell in the clefts of the rock?
questions.explanation: The pride of their heart has deceived them, as they say in their heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”

questions.text: What does the text say grape pickers would leave behind?
questions.explanation: The text asks whether grape pickers, if they came, would not leave some gleaning grapes.

questions.text: Whose hidden treasures does verse 6 say are sought out?
questions.explanation: The text cries out how Esau will be ransacked and how his hidden treasures are sought out.

questions.text: What do the friends who eat their bread do, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: The men who were at peace with them have deceived them, and friends who eat their bread lay a snare under them.

answers.text: They lay a snare under them

questions.text: Whose mighty men does Yahweh say will be dismayed?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that the mighty men of Teman will be dismayed, so that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau.

questions.text: What did strangers and foreigners do while Edom stood on the other side?
questions.explanation: In the day that strangers carried away his substance, foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem.

questions.text: What does verse 15 say will happen to Edom's deeds?
questions.explanation: As Edom has done it will be done to them, and their deeds will return upon their own head.

answers.text: They will be forgotten by Yahweh
They will return upon their own head
They will be told among the nations
They will be weighed in the balance

questions.text: What will the house of Esau be, where Jacob is a fire and Joseph a flame?
questions.explanation: The house of Jacob will be a fire and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau will be stubble that they burn and devour.

questions.text: Whose will the kingdom be, in the last verse of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh's.
